attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Montana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.mt_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mt_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Montana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Montana starts with federal taxable income and applies state modifications.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Montana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mt_state_additions = 0.0; if result.mt_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.mt_state_additions = result.mt_state_additions + result.mt_us_interest_income; endif set result.mt_state_subtractions = 0.0; if result.mt_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.mt_state_subtractions = result.mt_state_subtractions + result.mt_municipal_interest; endif add (("Montana additions: $" + string value of (result.mt_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.mt_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.mt_state_additions xdef { result.mt_state_additions result.mt_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.mt_state_additions xdef } {} result.mt_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.mt_state_subtractions xdef { result.mt_state_subtractions result.mt_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.mt_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.mt_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Montana additions: $" result.mt_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.mt_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Montana corporate income tax. Applies Montana flat rate (6.75% standard, 7.0% water's edge election) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.mt_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Montana corporate tax (standard rate 6.75%); Apply Montana 6.75% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mt_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.mt_apportioned_income + result.mt_state_additions - result.mt_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.mt_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.mt_taxable_income * result.mt_corp_tax_rate - result.mt_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.mt_refund_or_owed = result.mt_estimated_payments - result.mt_tax_liability; add "Montana taxable income: $" + string value of (result.mt_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Montana tax liability (6.75% standard rate): $" + string value of (result.mt_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.mt_apportioned_income result.mt_state_additions f+ result.mt_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mt_taxable_income xdef result.mt_taxable_income result.mt_corp_tax_rate fmul result.mt_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mt_tax_liability xdef result.mt_estimated_payments result.mt_tax_liability f- cvd /result.mt_refund_or_owed xdef "Montana taxable income: $" result.mt_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Montana tax liability (6.75% standard rate): $" result.mt_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Montana corporate tax (water's edge rate 7.0%); Apply Montana 7.0% water's edge rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.mt_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.mt_apportioned_income + result.mt_state_additions - result.mt_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.mt_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.mt_taxable_income * result.mt_corp_tax_rate_waters_edge - result.mt_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.mt_refund_or_owed = result.mt_estimated_payments - result.mt_tax_liability; add "Montana taxable income: $" + string value of (result.mt_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Montana tax liability (7.0% water's edge rate): $" + string value of (result.mt_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.mt_apportioned_income result.mt_state_additions f+ result.mt_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mt_taxable_income xdef result.mt_taxable_income result.mt_corp_tax_rate_waters_edge fmul result.mt_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.mt_tax_liability xdef result.mt_estimated_payments result.mt_tax_liability f- cvd /result.mt_refund_or_owed xdef "Montana taxable income: $" result.mt_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Montana tax liability (7.0% water's edge rate): $" result.mt_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
